items.comments: Roda had a very easy and efficient self-check in. She responded fast to my questions and helped us to make a reservation the same day. The place was clean and as it looked at the pics. Me and my boyfriend stayed at Rodas for two night and were satisfied with the experience.

The apartment was in excellent condition, and there were all the amenities I expected. It was very clean, and I was able to use it both as a work space as well as a sleeping space (I was in Seattle on a work trip).
Roda's place was in a good location, very clean and spacious apartment. Communication was effective and basic necessities were provided. Thanks for the stay - till next time!

Roda's description of the apartment was spot on!  Not only was it clean and very centrally located, but I was able to check in late due to work scheduling and my baggage claim debacle.  Otherwise she was extremely quick in her directions and response to my booking.  I literally booked this on wifi on my flight into Sea-Tac and had a confirmation before I landed.  The apartment is just a 5-10 minute walk from the space needle and if your good for a jog you can easily take a nice jog into downtown/pike market.  Or you can take the monorail from the space needle for $4.50 roundtrip! Not bad at all. Overall the place was fully equipped and Roda was a sweetheart in communicating with me.  I would definitely book again next time I'm in town!!  Thank you Roda!

Roda made using airbnb a seamless experience that was very enjoyable. She responds fast and made sure we had everything we need. The location was great and the interior was very modern despite the buildings exterior. Would definitely book this place again if I were to visit Seattle again in the future.
